integrity: An all-dimensional proof is provided; a standalone finite exhaustive checker corroborates the boundary and small mixed-alphabet cases. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted finite Cartesian products of complete graphs with all orders at least two. Does not classify larger inclusion-minimal transversals, general graph products, or weighted variants. Historical priority provisional.
title: Rigidity of minimum edge-geodesic transversals in mixed Hamming graphs
